newsitem.title: USA: Michael Foods Kohler unit settles suit.
newsitem.headline: Michael Foods Kohler unit settles suit.

text.p: Michael Foods Inc said Tuesday its Kohler Mix Specialties Inc subsidiary settled a lawsuit filed in May 1995 by Schwan's Sales Enterprises Inc.
Kohler Mix was one of three defendants in the suit, which involved a dispute over allegedly contaminated ice cream products sold by Schwan's.
The defendants and Schwan's have settled the suit and it has been dismissed.

The terms of the settlement are confidential, although the Kohler Mix portion of the settlement is within Michael Foods' insurance coverage, the company said. There was no determination of liability and no admission of guilt or wrongdoing by any of the defendants.
Michael Foods is a diversified food processor and distributor with particular interests in egg products, refrigerated grocery products, specialty dairy products and refrigerated potato products.
